sites.name: Chuckwalla National Monument

acres.source: Proclamation 10881 (approximately 624,270 acres of public land managed by BLM)

sites.description: About 624,000 acres of the Colorado Desert in Riverside and Imperial counties, California, between Joshua Tree National Park and the Salton Sea region. Managed by the Bureau of Land Management with co-stewardship by Tribal Nations. Its status is the subject of pending litigation.

sources.name: Proclamation 10881, Establishment of the Chuckwalla National Monument (January 14, 2025), Federal Register 2025-01441
